## Issues and scope / 이슈·범위

- Resolves a complete component issue / 완전히 해결하는 구성 이슈:
- Parent/integration issue (reference only until all criteria pass) / 전체 통합 전에는 참조만:
- Changed files and reason / 변경 파일·이유:
- Prior work or AI assistance requiring disclosure / 선행 작업·AI 활용:

Use `Closes #N` only for an issue fully resolved by this PR. Cross-repository closing requires `Closes owner/repo#N`. These are examples, not existing issue numbers. Do not auto-close an integration issue from one partial component PR.

- Payment/signing impact and reviewer / 지급·서명 영향·검토자:
- Rollback/recovery / 롤백·복구:

- [ ] Scope and acceptance match the linked issue / 이슈 인수 조건 일치

## Remaining limitations and handoff / 남은 제약·인계

Do not check a box merely because an agent claimed success. Record actual review/check evidence. Merge requires the authorized human workflow; a generated PR does not grant merge authority.
